name: What Becomes of Her
source:
Join Daria, as she leaves her familiar village during the Midsummer night to embark on a journey to find the mythical fern flower, which might be the key to her happy future. 

[From [url=https://pandel.itch.io/what-becomes-of-her]Itch.io[/url]]
